summary: Sprint 6 (Design System & Light/Dark Mode) verified end-to-end via UI at both desktop (1280x900) and mobile (390x844) widths against seed account sb_1785767871@studio.com and seed project c73286507b42. FRONTEND: (1) Theme tiles theme-system/theme-light/theme-dark switch the WHOLE app instantly with no reload and no visible flash — verified visually on Settings, Dashboard, Projects, Templates, New Project wizard (step 1), and the seeded editor's Overview / Storyboard (8 scene cards) / Shot List / Script tabs. (2) AsyncStorage persistence confirmed: set Light -> reload -> app still Light; set Dark -> reload -> app still Dark. (3) System mode selected without error (uses device colorScheme fallback). (4) On desktop 1280, density-compact is enabled; on mobile 390 density-compact has aria-disabled='true' with subtext 'Not available on mobile' and clicking it is a no-op (comfortable stays selected). Density-large & density-comfortable switch cleanly. (5) toggle-reduce-motion and toggle-high-contrast toggle on/off; high-contrast noticeably strengthens borders/text per applyHighContrast() token override. (6) AI Director side panel opens via director-open and renders correctly in BOTH themes (director-input visible in both), closes via director-close. Real AI Apply intentionally NOT triggered — seed preserved. (7) All screens themed correctly in both modes: NO dark leftovers in Light (verified via screenshots — white/off-white cards, warm-charcoal text, gold accent chips), NO white flashes in Dark. (8) Login works with seeded credentials (redirects to /dashboard). (9) Editor's root View is correctly keyed by resolvedTheme — memoized scene cards remount and re-theme on toggle (verified by navigating away, changing theme, and returning). (10) Warnings observed (cosmetic, pre-existing from iteration_7): shadow* style prop deprecated on react-native-web; React 19 element.ref deprecation. No red screens, no PAGEERRORs. NOTE: Backend testing was intentionally SKIPPED per the review request (testing_type: frontend only).

'Accessing element.ref was removed in React 19. ref is now a regular prop.' — cosmetic, likely from a dependency. Appears once on editor mount. Not a regression from this sprint.

critical_code_review_comments: ThemeProvider correctly gates first render on `hydrated` from AsyncStorage.multiGet, preventing a first-frame flash of the wrong theme.

ThemeProvider useMemo dependency array covers all state that affects the returned value (mode, resolvedTheme, density, reduceMotion, highContrast, isPhone, plus stable setters) — instant switch works because setMode triggers state -> memo -> C -> every screen's useMemo(createStyles(C), [C]) rebuilds.
Effective density correctly downgrades compact -> comfortable when isPhone, so the scale factor is safe even if a persisted 'compact' was set while the user was on desktop.
applyHighContrast() only strengthens borders/text semantics (border.subtle=default, border.default=strong, text.secondary=primary) — preserves the palette contract without introducing new token keys.
settings.tsx uses `const styles = useMemo(() => createStyles(C), [C])` — the canonical pattern that makes every screen theme-live. Verified on all screens.
app/_layout.tsx wraps AuthProvider inside ThemeProvider so auth-gated screens can read C — good ordering.
Densities and a11y flags are also persisted (KEY_DENSITY, KEY_REDUCE_MOTION, KEY_HIGH_CONTRAST). Good.

MINOR: settings.tsx never uses the `useAppTheme.scale` multiplier when rendering its own font sizes — density affects other screens but Settings font-sizes stay static. Not a bug per the spec (density is 'workspace density' for the editing surfaces), but worth noting.
